CLAUDE.md must be amended to reflect the new terminology as a prior governance action, since it is the highest-priority interpretive authority and currently uses 'Layer 2'/'Layer 3' throughout.
DOCUMENTATION_VERIFICATION_MATRIX_v1.md must be consulted to map all cross-document references affected by the rename.
SYSTEM_TECHNICAL_HANDBOOK_v1.md must define the explicit constraint boundary distinguishing architectural naming from code module names and import paths.
README_LAYER2.md rename requires prior governance amendment of CLAUDE.md Section 2.1 to update the canonical document list.
SYSTEM_IMPLEMENTATION_RECORD_v1.md must identify which Layer 3 references are historical vs current-state before any substitution.
Orchestration workflow authorisation (CLAUDE.md Section 15) must be confirmed for the full refactor scope.
SYSTEM_LIMITATIONS_AND_APPROXIMATIONS_v1.md must be reviewed for limitation-boundary implications of the rename.

The new terminology (truth_store, decision_layer) must be verified to not alter claim scope, evidence classification, canonical role mapping, or current-vs-target labeling. Currently unverifiable because the new terms are absent from canonical sources.

execution_sequence_if_unblocked: Step 1: Establish new terms in SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE_AND_BUILD_SEQUENCE_v1.md as canonical architectural names.
Step 2: Amend CLAUDE.md to adopt the new terminology, updating all sections while preserving every semantic invariant.
Step 3: Update CLAUDE.md Section 2.1 to reflect any canonical filename changes (README_LAYER2.md → new name).

Step 4: Update Tier 1 canonical documents (README_v1.md, SYSTEM_TECHNICAL_HANDBOOK_v1.md, SYSTEM_LIMITATIONS_AND_APPROXIMATIONS_v1.md, SYSTEM_IMPLEMENTATION_RECORD_v1.md) with new terminology, preserving historical references.
Step 5: Rename README_LAYER2.md file and update its content.
Step 6: Update DOCUMENTATION_VERIFICATION_MATRIX_v1.md with all cross-reference changes and verify no evidence classification drift.
Step 8: Update system-orchestration.yaml if it contains affected references.
Step 9: Run full verification pipeline to confirm cross-reference integrity and semantic invariance.
